t: This is Sackville Street, in the City of Westminster. Today it's mostly offices, along with the rear of retail premises, but it was once home to several important medical figures. John Weld-Forester, the second Baron Forester, was born here in 1801. He became a Tory politician and served under Sir Robert Peel as Captain of the Honourable Corps of Gentlemen-at-Arms from 1841 to 1846.
